During the six months ended June 30, 2024 we were advanced $1,400,000 and $149,500 Canadian Dollars (US Dollars $109,225) in the form of a short -term note. During the six months ended June 30, 2024 we applied advances of $328,003 to the note balance. The balance owing at June 30, 2024 was $1,181,222.
